subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should Skill Workshop lifecycle approvals use the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 design, which bounds the approval wait inside the Codex tool budget and returns actionable pending-state guidance, instead of the older longer-TTL-only fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94315?
rationale: The central choice changes the generated-skill approval boundary and operator timeout semantics, so automation should not choose between a shorter bounded approval window, a longer review window, or a new config surface without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use the broader bounded-approval fix
options.body: Review and land or revise https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 so the tool returns before the Codex watchdog and exposes proposal context plus actionable timeout behavior.

options.title: Prefer a longer approval TTL
options.body: Revise the fix direction toward a longer or configurable Skill Workshop approval window and explicitly accept the Codex watchdog and security-boundary tradeoffs.

options.title: Decline agent-tool lifecycle approval changes
options.body: Close the linked fix PRs and document the CLI or `approvalPolicy: "auto"` workaround as the supported path for delayed approvals.

recommendation.title: Use the broader bounded-approval fix
recommendation.body: Review and land or revise https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 so the tool returns before the Codex watchdog and exposes proposal context plus actionable timeout behavior.
